blocks.text: This article explains how to leverage various features available in the Business Insights Admin Portal to view accurate and rich applications and workplace insights. Business Insights is divided into two categories—applications and workplace—and also includes reports and administration management to manage your admins. To learn more, see What Is Zscaler Business Insights? and Understanding Business Insights Architecture.

To view your organization's SaaS application and its contract insights to make business-critical decisions like offloading applications, reducing licenses, and switching to more cost-effective alternatives, consider configuring the following features:

blocks.item: To view accurate application insights about their usage, active and inactive users, and costs—among many other vital metrics—consider configuring sanctioned applications to pull usage information and view insights. Zscaler recommends configuring a SaaS application connector (requires admin access to the app) for the supported apps, or creating custom application signatures to pull metrics from a specific URL of the application per your requirements. To learn more, see About Application Configuration.

While configuring applications helps in viewing accurate insights, uploading application contracts with all your vendors helps in managing and viewing annual contract value (ACV), total contract value (TCV), SaaS spending, deadlines, and licensing models. To learn more, see About Contracts.
Tags for linking applications and contracts to user-defined tags. Tagging is leveraged as a filtering option for viewing insights. To learn more, see About Application Tags and About Contract Tags.

blocks.text: After configuring the preceding features, refer to the following articles to view and analyze application insights in the Business Insights Admin Portal:

blocks.item: About Application Insights
About All Applications
Viewing Application Overlap Details
Viewing Application Details

blocks.text: To view your organization's workplace insights to manage your workforce and workplace more effectively, and also make business-critical decisions like opening, shutting down, and optimizing offices, consider configuring the following features:

blocks.item: Offices for all your workplaces that are being used by your organization to efficiently track and manage the workforce and workplaces. To learn more, see About Configured Offices.

Organization and office-level attendance goals to gauge workplace attendance against the defined goals. To learn more, see Configuring Organization-Level Occupancy & Attendance Goals and Configuring Occupancy & Attendance Goals for an Office.
Department Mapping to categorize multiple departments into a division to filter and view workplace insights for specific divisions. To learn more, see About Department Mapping.
Tags for linking offices to user-defined tags. Tagging is leveraged as a filtering option for viewing insights for workplaces. To learn more, see About Workplace Tags.

blocks.text: You can download system-generated reports and also schedule applications and workplace reports. To learn more, see Downloading Business Insights Reports, About Application Reports, and About Workplace Reports.
To effectively manage admins in the Business Insights Admin Portal, configure the following features:

blocks.item: Role-Based Administration to delegate different types of admins to the Business Insights Admin Portal. To learn more, see Configuring Role-Based Administration.
Administrator Management Settings to define parameters for admins' password, SAML authentication, and SCIM. To learn more, see Understanding Administrator Management Settings.
SAML single sign-on (SSO) based on the IdP of your choice:
SAML Configuration Guide for Microsoft Entra ID
SAML Configuration Guide for Okta
Workflow Automation to manage users' application provisioning status based on their various usage criteria defined in Scheduled Reports.
